bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
wt="$root/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
target=b60db57fee09bf525c9ec5747acd8f07e32d7f97
base=87e879c0c3cea9da8c02c159790085ba3d934e24
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
old_sha=148b6353ac17d5351fd12a07276c15f0c69f575ab8fadc62238e6cc3c5a98681
new_sha=83da915b8f48be5ae4577042501d2bf5acd89520a453c3a9b75868cda496a7ee
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$base"
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)"
git -C "$wt" fetch origin refs/heads/fix/notice-live-adopted-20261127
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target"
git -C "$wt" merge --ff-only "$target"
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
stage=deploy/state/notice-pr81-b60db57f
test ! -e "$stage"
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
test "$(gh run view 46029906817 -R "$repo" --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$target success"
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/actions/artifacts/15212989518 --jq '.workflow_run.head_sha')" = "$target"
gh run download 46029906817 -R "$repo" -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$stage"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
printf '%s\n' 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local' 'USER root' 'COPY --chown=node:node --chmod=600 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs' 'USER node' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-b60db57f
docker build --network none --pull=false -q -t "$tag" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$tag" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$tag" /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' "$tag")" = node
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")"
printf '{"source_sha":"%s","old_image":"%s","old_sha":"%s","new_image":"%s","new_sha":"%s","artifact_run":46029906817,"artifact_id":15212989518}\n' "$target" "$old_image" "$old_sha" "$new_image" "$new_sha" > "$stage/checkpoint.json"
echo NOTICE_FIX_IMAGE_STAGED=PASS
